lines.en: label utaspring4:
scene nightsky
: Uta, where the fuck are we going?
lines.zh: : Uta，我们到底要去他妈的哪儿？

lines.en: : Just trust me, okay?! I know a spot.
lines.zh: : 相信我就行，好吗？！我知道一个地方。

lines.en: : We already have a spot, though.
lines.zh: : 可我们已经有一个地方了啊。

lines.en: : Yes, but this time we’re going to my {i}Io{/i} spot.
lines.zh: : 是，不过这次我们要去我的{i}Io{/i}专属地点。

lines.en: : I knew you were Io this whole time. From the moment I set foot in the bath house. Don’t think I’ll be deceived by your surprisingly large and clearly fake breasts.
lines.zh: : 我从头到尾都知道你是 Io。从我踏进澡堂的那一刻起。别以为我会被你那对大得出奇、一看就是假的胸部骗到。

lines.en: : Fake?! You wound me, Sen- no. Mas- no. Akira!
lines.zh: : 假的？！你伤到我了，老——不。主——不。Akira！

lines.en: : That’s the point, U- no. I- no. Uo.
lines.zh: : 重点就在这儿，U——不。I——不。Uo。

lines.en: : I’m a fish now?!
lines.zh: : 我现在是条鱼了？！

lines.en: I torment her tirelessly. It’s my way of getting back at her for the amount of times she’s blue-balled me so far.
lines.zh: 我不知疲倦地捉弄她。这是我对她迄今为止让我那么多次欲求不满的报复方式。

lines.en: It’s also just fun, though.
lines.zh: 不过说到底，这也很好玩。

lines.en: Being {i}with{/i} her is fun.
lines.zh: 和她{i}在一起{/i}很好玩。

lines.en: And...weirdly different in a way that’s hard to quantify.
lines.zh: 而且……有种难以言喻的、奇怪的不同。

lines.en: Almost natural to a certain extent.
lines.zh: 在某种程度上近乎自然。

lines.en: Maybe it’s just because she’s so experienced when it comes to dealing with Io — and {i}that{/i} is a girl I have a lot in common with.
lines.zh: 也许只是因为她应付 Io 的经验丰富——而{i}那个{/i}女孩跟我有不少共同点。

lines.en: But maybe it’s something better. Brighter. Bigger?
lines.zh: 但也可能是更好的东西。更明亮的？更大的？

lines.en: Whatever it is, I’m content — for I could stare at the back of her head in every single context for the rest of my life and still believe I’ve done all I was put here to do.
lines.zh: 不管是什么，我很满足——因为我可以余生里在任何情境下盯着她的后脑勺看，并且依然相信我已经完成了我被放到这个世上要做的一切。

lines.en: scene black
: Wait, here?
lines.zh: : 等等，这儿？

lines.en: : Mhmmm. Just {i}trust{/i} me. Like I said.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。就像我说的，{i}相信{/i}我。

lines.en: Uta slides a lighter out of her pocket. I’m not sure why she has one or what she plans to do with it.
lines.zh: Uta 从口袋里掏出一个打火机。我不知道她为什么会有这东西，也不知道她打算拿它干什么。

lines.en: But as we make our way below ground, it begins to become clear.
lines.zh: 但随着我们往地下走，事情开始明朗起来。

lines.en: She leads me to the end of a long tunnel and tells me to sit down.
lines.zh: 她领我走到一条长隧道的尽头，让我坐下。

lines.en: scene utatunnel1
Which is what brings us here.
lines.zh: 这就是我们此刻来到这儿的原因。

lines.en: : Where are we?
lines.zh: : 我们在哪儿？

lines.en: : A secret tunnel. Like in Avatar.
lines.zh: : 一条秘密隧道。就像《Avatar》里那样。

lines.en: : The James Cameron movie?
lines.zh: : James Cameron 那部电影？

lines.en: : I can’t believe you just said that to me.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信你居然对我说得出这种话。

lines.en: : Uta, why do you know about a secret tunnel? And why does it look like people live down here?
lines.zh: : Uta，你为什么会知道一条秘密隧道？还有为什么这里看起来像是有人住在下头？

lines.en: : Because they probably do. This thing runs from here all the way to the old district.
lines.zh: : 因为大概真的有吧。这玩意儿从这儿一直通到老城区。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: scene utatunnel2
: Ooooh? You don’t know?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦？你不知道吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have asked if I did. I’m not the type to do that just to let someone feel good about knowing stuff.
lines.zh: : 我要是知道就不会问了。我不是那种为了让人卖弄知识而故意提问的人。

lines.en: : Well, Akira — legend has it that when Kumon-mi was first being built, it was only meant to be the old district.
lines.zh: : 那么，Akira——传说 Kumon-mi 最初开建的时候，本来只打算建老城区那一块。

lines.en: : I assumed as much based on the fact that it is literally called the “old district.”
lines.zh: : 光看它字面就叫“老城区”，我也猜到了。

lines.en: : Right, because you didn’t let me finish. But what if the {i}new{/i} district was actually the older of the two?
lines.zh: : 对，因为你没让我说完。可如果{i}新{/i}城区其实才是两者中更老的那个呢？

lines.en: : Then the people in charge of city planning here are chaotic and terrible at naming things.
lines.zh: : 那这儿负责城市规划的人就是一群混乱分子，而且起名烂透了。

lines.en: scene utatunnel3
: That’s one possibility, yes. {i}Or...{/i}we have a conspiracy on our hands.
lines.zh: : 这是一种可能，没错。{i}不过{/i}……我们手上是有一桩阴谋的。

lines.en: : Because {i}I{/i} heard that these tunnels were constructed in secret to bridge the gap between the two districts without the {i}true{/i} older district ever finding out.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}我{/i}听说，这些隧道是秘密修建的，用来把两个城区连起来，而{i}真正{/i}更老的那个城区永远不会发现。

lines.en: : Mhm. I feel like you might be underestimating how hard it is to build a tunnel of this magnitude in secret.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我觉得你可能低估了秘密修建这种规模的隧道有多难。

lines.en: : Maybe if it was built by conventional means...but what if the old district is actually {i}alive?{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果是用常规方式修的，也许吧……可如果老城区其实是{i}活的{/i}呢？

lines.en: scene utatunnel4
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : What if, and hear me out here, the tunnel...{i}built itself?{/i} To try and connect to something that already existed! Like a-
lines.zh: : 你听我说完——如果这条隧道……{i}是自己长出来的{/i}呢？为了试着连接到某个已经存在的东西！就像一个——

lines.en: : Like a parasite?
lines.zh: : 像一个寄生虫？

lines.en: scene utatunnel5
: Bingo! When Kumon-mi was first being built, they wanted to create a new type of city that was self-sustainable. But little did they know...it would actually come to life!
lines.zh: : 答对了！Kumon-mi 最初开建的时候，他们想造一座能自我维持的新型城市。可他们万万没想到……它居然活了过来！

lines.en: scene utatunnel6
: But it was starved for resources and energy! And the ones in charge, desperate to create a brand new type of city, ran out of funding halfway through and had to quit!
lines.zh: : 但它缺乏资源和能量！而当权者急着要造一座全新的城市，资金在半途就烧光了，不得不停工！

lines.en: scene utatunnel7
: This left the old district scared and desperate...so it sunk its roots into the earth and connected itself to the first thing it found!
lines.zh: : 这让老城区又害怕又绝望……于是它把根扎进土里，连接到它找到的第一样东西上！

lines.en: scene utatunnel8
: Which brings us here!
lines.zh: : 于是我们就来到了这儿！

lines.en: scene utatunnel9
: Okay.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : So do you know what this tunnel {i}actually{/i} is or should I just pretend to believe all of that?
lines.zh: : 那你知道这条隧道{i}到底{/i}是什么吗，还是我应该假装相信你刚才那一套？

lines.en: : Well, let me ask you this — does anybody {i}actually{/i} know anything about Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 那我问你——有谁{i}真的{/i}了解过 Kumon-mi 的什么吗？

lines.en: : Because I couldn’t find like, any info on it at all before I moved here. And all of the stuff I’ve heard about the way it {i}used{/i} to be is stuff people heard from people who heard it from...other people.
lines.zh: : 因为我搬来之前，关于它的信息我一点都查不到。而我听说的那些关于它{i}过去{/i}是什么样子的说法，都是人们从别人那儿听来的，而那些人又是从……别的人那儿听来的。

lines.en: : I guess it {i}is{/i} kind of weird if there’s no...information on that stuff. But the weirdest part of all is just straight up what goes on in the old district.
lines.zh: : 我猜如果关于那些事真的一点资料都没有，那{i}确实{/i}有点怪。但最怪的还是老城区里到底在上演什么。

lines.en: : Yeah, that place gives me the heebie-jeebies. But that’s further proof that something’s wonky about it, don’t you think?!
lines.zh: : 是啊，那地方让我起一身鸡皮疙瘩。可这更证明了那里有什么不对劲，你不觉得吗？！

lines.en: : I don’t think we need a full blown conspiracy to land on the fact that that place is creepy, Uta.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们不需要搬出一整套阴谋论，才能得出“那地方很阴森”这个结论吧，Uta。

lines.en: : No, we don’t. But the fact that the difference between here and there is so drastic just...I don’t know. I think there’s something weird going on. So {i}I’m{/i} going to keep believing the city is alive. Just like our dorm.
lines.zh: : 是不需要。但这里和那里的差别如此之大，就……我也不知道。我觉得有什么奇怪的事在发生。所以{i}我{/i}会继续相信这座城市是活的。就像我们的宿舍一样。

lines.en: : So the dorm is alive too now?
lines.zh: : 那宿舍现在也是活的了？

lines.en: scene utatunnel10
: Well, yeah! It’s gotta be! There are so many floors and we only use three of them. What if all its organs and stuff are in the floors above us and that’s why the other classes haven’t moved in yet?
lines.zh: : 嗯，对啊！它肯定是！楼层那么多，我们只用了三层。要是它的器官什么的都在我们上面那几层，所以其他班才一直没搬进来呢？

lines.en: : Because...the school doesn’t want to...kill a sentient building?
lines.zh: : 因为……学校不想……杀掉一栋有知觉的建筑？

lines.en: scene utatunnel11
: Yes.
: You’re a bad theorist.
lines.zh: : 你是个糟糕的理论家。

lines.en: : I just go off vibes.
lines.zh: : 我只是凭感觉来的。

lines.en: : Well, can you {i}vibe{/i} out an explanation as to why you and Io hang out in a weird tunnel that you think is alive?
lines.zh: : 那你能不能{i}凭感觉{/i}给我一个解释，为什么你和 Io 会泡在一条你觉得是活物的怪隧道里？

lines.en: scene utatunnel12
: We’ve been coming down here since before we even transferred. Barely do it anymore, though...now that there isn’t really much of a need for it and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我们还没转学过来之前就一直往这儿跑了。不过现在基本不来了……因为也没什么必要了什么的。

lines.en: scene utatunnel4
: Io can’t do her hardcore woodworking stuff at her aunt’s house, and our last school wouldn’t let her use the woodshop unsupervised. And me — I just wanted a place to shoot my crossbow.
lines.zh: : Io 不能在她阿姨家搞她那些硬核木工活，而我们上一所学校又不让她在没有监督的情况下用木工教室。至于我——我只是想要个地方射我的弩。

lines.en: : So the two of you would sneak into a creepy tunnel that is definitely inhabited by homeless people for the sake of woodworking and archery?
lines.zh: 所以你们俩会偷偷溜进一条肯定有无家可归的人住着的阴森隧道，就为了做木工和射箭？

lines.en: : Yup! That about sums it up.
lines.zh: : 对！基本就是这么回事。

lines.en: : And that mattress behind you?
lines.zh: : 那你身后那张床垫呢？

lines.en: : Idunno. Probably belongs to one of the homeless people.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。大概是哪个流浪汉的。

lines.en: scene utatunnel13
: We’ve never actually {i}seen{/i} anybody down here, though. And the only reason we know it’s connected to the old district is because we overheard some people talking about it at our old school.
lines.zh: : 不过我们其实从来没在这下面{i}见过{/i}任何人。我们之所以知道它通到老城区，是因为在我们以前的学校里无意中听到有人提起过。

lines.en: : They always said this place was impossible to find, though. Which is weird because me and Io found it after, like...two nights of searching.
lines.zh: : 不过他们总说这地方是不可能找到的。可奇怪的是，我和 Io 找了大概……两个晚上就找到了。

lines.en: : Probably just another urban legend or something. Those are popular in schools nowadays, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 大概又是什么都市传说之类的。那种东西现在在学校里挺流行的，不是吗？

lines.en: : Were they not when you went to school?
lines.zh: : 你上学那会儿不流行吗？

lines.en: : I...can’t remember much about school, to be honest. They might have been?
lines.zh: : 说实话……学校的事我记不太清了。也许流行过吧？

lines.en: scene utatunnel14
: Come to think of it, Kumon-mi High doesn’t really have any. At least none that can’t be traced back to stuff Nodoka makes up whenever she gets her crazy eyes.
lines.zh: : 这么说来，Kumon-mi 高中其实没什么都市传说。至少除了那些能追溯到 Nodoka 一翻白眼就瞎编出来的东西之外没有。

lines.en: : She’s not doing that in school now, is she?
lines.zh: : 她现在在学校里没干那个吧？

lines.en: scene utatunnel13
: Oh, right. I guess you wouldn’t know unless somebody told you. But yeah — she’s been all sorts of weird ever since the Halloween party. In like a...less Nodoka-ish way, though.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我想没人告诉你你就不知道。不过没错——从万圣节派对之后她就一直怪怪的。虽然是……一种不太像 Nodoka 的怪法。

lines.en: : Which means...what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 也就是说……具体是怎么样？

lines.en: : Well, when she’s not going crazy, she mostly just keeps to herself now. I haven’t even seen her hit on Miss Watabe recently. That was the biggest tip that something was off.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她不发疯的时候，现在基本就自己待着。我最近连她搭讪 Watabe 老师都没见过了。那是最明显的信号，说明有什么不对劲。

lines.en: scene utatunnel15
: Is there...anything else you’ve noticed?
lines.zh: : 你还注意到……别的什么吗？

lines.en: : With Nodoka?
lines.zh: : Nodoka 的？

lines.en: : Or anyone. I don’t normally ask Ami about what goes on in school, so...
lines.zh: : 谁的都行。我平时不会问 Ami 学校里的事，所以……

lines.en: : Hmm...Kirin’s a little nicer. Chika’s...uhh...{i}odd.{/i} And I think Rin might like her again because she’s always staring at her recently.
lines.zh: : 嗯……Kirin 变亲切了一点。Chika 嘛……呃……{i}怪怪的{/i}。还有我觉得 Rin 可能又喜欢上她了，因为她最近老盯着她看。

lines.en: : Oh, also! I want Noriko and Yumi to make out. Their sexual tension rivals even ours.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有！我想看 Noriko 和 Yumi 亲热。她俩的性张力连我们都比不上。

lines.en: : Yumi is straight.
lines.zh: : Yumi 是直的。

lines.en: scene utatunnel16
: She can have a curious phase! It happens to all of us. Just...mine happened to last forever. And is only worsened by the fact that everyone in our class is highly kissable.
lines.zh: 她可以有好奇的阶段啊！我们都会有。只不过……我的那个阶段碰巧持续了一辈子。而且我们班上每个人都特别好亲，这让情况更加恶化。

lines.en: : But none are more kissable than you, Uta.
lines.zh: : 但没人比你好亲，Uta。

lines.en: scene utatunnel17
: Yet alas — no ring.
lines.zh: : 可惜啊——没有戒指。

lines.en: : You’re really set on this ring thing, huh?
lines.zh: : 你对这个戒指的事还真是执着，是吧？

lines.en: scene utatunnel18
: Believe it or not, I’m very traditional. I’m just also...highly irresponsible when it comes to...Internet communications.
lines.zh: : 信不信由你，我很传统。我只是……在网络交流方面又特别不负责任。

lines.en: : So, like...you {i}actually{/i} want to wait until marriage?
lines.zh: : 所以，就是说……你{i}真的{/i}想等到结婚？

lines.en: scene utatunnel19
: I mean...I don’t think it has to be {i}marriage.{/i} But I’d definitely want to be dating somebody before anything actually {i}happens,{/i} you know?
lines.zh: : 我是说……我觉得不一定要{i}结婚{/i}。但我肯定希望在真正{i}发生{/i}什么之前，先和对方在交往，你懂吧？

lines.en: : So {i}that’s{/i} why you’ve so easily avoided my advances this whole time.
lines.zh: : 所以{i}这才是{/i}你这么久以来能这么轻易躲开我所有攻势的原因。

lines.en: scene utatunnel20
: There’s also the fact that none of those “advances” have been real. It’s always just flirting.
lines.zh: : 还有一点是，那些“攻势”根本就没有一次是真的。一直都只是调情而已。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Jerking off to mini-Uta doesn’t count. That’s not an advance either. But yeah, I’m all talk. I’m sure you’ve figured that out about me by now.
lines.zh: : 对着迷你 Uta 打飞机不算。那也不算攻势。不过是啊，我就是嘴上功夫。我想你到现在已经看出我这一点了。

lines.en: : You’re not {i}all{/i} talk if you keep putting yourself in situations like this where we’re all alone. Because the {i}last{/i} person who did that with me-
lines.zh: : 如果你一直把自己放到这种只有我们两个独处的局面里，那你就不{i}只是{/i}嘴上功夫了。因为{i}上一个{/i}跟我这么做的——

lines.en: scene utatunnel21
: Bzzt. No talking about other girls when your attention should be on Uta. You’ll make her jealous and cause what few morals she has left to begin blurring.
lines.zh: : 哔哔。不许在注意力该放在 Uta 身上的时候聊别的女孩。你会让她嫉妒，让她仅剩的那点道德开始模糊。

lines.en: : You’re one of the most morally good people I know, Uta. You’ve just...done some questionable things out of loneliness in the past. Which isn’t bad. We all break every now and then.
lines.zh: : 你是我认识的人里道德最高尚的人之一，Uta。你只是……过去因为孤独做过一些有问题的选择。那不坏。我们都会有崩溃的时候。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: scene utatunnel22
: In a way, though...me “breaking” brought us closer together.
lines.zh: : 不过从某种意义上说……我的“崩溃”让我们更亲近了。

lines.en: : Like...if I’d never found out about the picture thing, I don’t know if I’d have {i}ever{/i} gotten the courage to tell you how I really feel.
lines.zh: : 就像……如果我从没发现照片那件事，我不知道自己是否{i}还能{/i}鼓起勇气告诉你我的真实感受。

lines.en: scene utatunnel23
: So being unclean isn’t {i}all{/i} bad, right?
lines.zh: : 所以不干净也不{i}全{/i}是坏事，对吧？

lines.en: : You’re not {i}unclean,{/i} Uta.
lines.zh: : 你不是{i}不干净{/i}，Uta。

lines.en: : No, I’m just fap material for a whole bunch of horny losers all over the globe.
lines.zh: : 不，我只是遍布全球的饥渴卢瑟们的撸管素材罢了。

lines.en: scene utatunnel24
: Akira not included, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然不包括 Akira。

lines.en: scene utatunnel25
: Well, thank you for making an exception to-
lines.zh: : 嗯，谢谢你为我破例——

lines.en: : God fucking damn it, it happened again.
lines.zh: : 我操他妈的，又来了。

lines.en: : Wait, just now? Seriously?
lines.zh: : 等等，就刚刚？认真的？

lines.en: scene utatunnel26
: Yup! The timing’s so great that I get to worry about my phone being bugged now! Hooray!
lines.zh: : 对！时机好得我现在还得担心手机被装了窃听器！万岁！

lines.en: : Can’t you, like...turn it into the police or something?
lines.zh: 你就不能……把它交给警察什么的吗？

lines.en: scene utatunnel27
: I do. Or...did. But after doing it a zillion times and nothing coming of it, I just don’t even find it worth it to file the reports anymore.
lines.zh: : 我交过。或者说……以前交过。可在做了无数次、什么结果都没有之后，我连报案都觉得不值得了。

lines.en: : This person or...{i}people{/i} want to torment me. That much is obvious. All I can really do is just...learn how to deal with it, I guess.
lines.zh: : 这个人……或者{i}这些人{/i}想折磨我。这点很明显。我能做的其实也就是……学会怎么应付它吧，我想。

lines.en: scene utatunnel28
: Still sucks, though. But hey — I wanted attention and {i}now{/i} I’m getting it.
lines.zh: : 不过还是糟心。可话说回来——我想要关注，而{i}现在{/i}我得到了。

lines.en: : You still shouldn’t have to deal with that.
lines.zh: : 你还是不该承受这些。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : Maybe I should just ditch my phone entirely? Start living more...disconnected.
lines.zh: : 也许我干脆彻底扔掉手机？开始过更……断网的生活。

lines.en: : You can be like me. Like 50%% of my phone usage is just telling Ami I’m going to be coming home late.
lines.zh: : 你可以像我一样。我手机大概 50% 的用途就是告诉 Ami 我要晚回家。

lines.en: scene utatunnel29
: Or I could lean fully into the virtual world instead and coerce you into {i}connecting{/i} as well so we can follow each other and send each other selfies all day.
lines.zh: : 或者我干脆完全投身虚拟世界，顺便把你也拉进来{i}连上网{/i}，这样我们就能互相关注、整天互发自拍。

lines.en: : I thought you couldn’t send picture messages?
lines.zh: : 你不是不能发图片消息吗？

lines.en: : Not normally. Social media exists, though. Don’t tell my parents.
lines.zh: : 正常来说不行。不过社交媒体是存在的。别告诉我爸妈。

lines.en: : I’ve never wanted to join social media more than I do right now.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子从没像现在这样想注册社交媒体。

lines.en: scene utatunnel26
: I’m very easy to coerce into sending nudes too!
lines.zh: : 而且我很容易被哄着发裸照哦！

lines.en: : Uta, come on-
lines.zh: : Uta，别这样——

lines.en: scene utatunnel30
: Do you want to see it?
lines.zh: : 你想看吗？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene utatunnel31
: I hold in my hands what could potentially be the {i}holy grail{/i} of your spank bank until you finally make your move, Akira.
lines.zh: : 我手里拿着的，可能是你那套撸管收藏里的{i}圣杯{/i}——在你终于动手之前，Akira。

lines.en: : You’re...seriously not {i}offering{/i} to-
lines.zh: : 你……该不会真的{i}要{/i}——

lines.en: : I told you. It doesn’t bother me when {i}you{/i} see them. I {i}like{/i} the attention, remember? Don’t you want to see me literally {i}begging{/i} for it?
lines.zh: : 我说过的。{i}你{/i}看到那些我不介意。我{i}喜欢{/i}被关注，记得吗？你不想看我字面意义上{i}求着{/i}你吗？

lines.en: scene utatunnel32
: Don’t you?...
lines.zh: : 你不想吗？……

lines.en: : {i}Yes.{/i}
: That’s the problem.
lines.zh: : 问题就在这儿。

lines.en: : It’s...not, though.
lines.zh: : 可这……不是问题啊。

lines.en: : Didn’t you personally ask me if I wanted help?
lines.zh: : 不是你亲口问过我需不需要帮助吗？

lines.en: : Is {i}this{/i} really your answer to that? Tapping into my biggest weakness? My biggest flaw?
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}就是你给的答案？利用我最大的弱点？我最大的缺陷？

lines.en: scene utatunnel33
: Oh my god...
lines.zh: : 我的天哪……

lines.en: scene utatunnel34
: You’re right...you’re so right! What the fuck am I doing?!
lines.zh: : 你说得对……你太对了！我他妈的在干什么啊？！

lines.en: : I’m sorry! I...it’s how I...feel better about...my...oh my god.
lines.zh: : 对不起！我……这是我让自己……对……感觉好一点的方式……我的……天哪。

lines.en: scene utatunnel35
: AAAAAH! Forget I said that! I...wasn’t thinking! I just...I saw it and my mind went to...aaah! I’m such a fucking whore! I’m such a desperate piece of filthy fucking-
lines.zh: 啊啊啊啊！当我没说！我……没过脑子！我只是……我看到了然后脑子就想到……啊啊！我真是个他妈的婊子！我真是个饥渴的、脏到他妈的——

lines.en: : Uta...stop.
lines.zh: : Uta……停下。

lines.en: : I wish I could! But I’m a useless piece of shit and I just can’t, Sensei! I can’t take it anymore! I can’t-
lines.zh: : 我也想啊！可我是个没用的废物，我就是停不下来，Sensei！我受不了了！我受不——

lines.en: : Akira.
lines.zh: : Akira。

lines.en: scene utatunnel36
: You’re supposed to call me Akira now.
lines.zh: : 你现在该叫我 Akira。

lines.en: scene utatunnel37
: How are you not disgusted by me?
lines.zh: : 你怎么就不觉得我恶心呢？

lines.en: : I ask myself the same question constantly, just with the roles reversed.
lines.zh: : 我也一直在问自己同样的问题，只不过角色对调了。

lines.en: : I’m far more abhorrent than you’ll ever be though, Uta.
lines.zh: : 不过我远比你将来的任何时候都要可憎，Uta。

lines.en: : {i}Sniffle.{/i}
: What does abhorrent mean?...
lines.zh: : 可憎是什么意思？……

lines.en: : Repugnant.
lines.zh: : 令人反感。

lines.en: : {i}Sniffle.{/i}
: What does repugnant mean?...
lines.zh: : 反感是什么意思？……

lines.en: : That I’m disgusting and undesirable and unfit for love.
lines.zh: : 就是说我很恶心、不值得被要、不配得到爱。

lines.en: : Then why am I still so horny?...
lines.zh: : 那我为什么还这么发骚？……

lines.en: scene utatunnel38
: I think you’re just doomed to always feel that way until I become someone worthy of your time.
lines.zh: : 我想，在我变成一个配得上你时间的人之前，你注定会一直这么觉得。

lines.en: : There’s no one {i}more{/i} worthy of my time than you. I’d take every hand off every clock if it would help you realize that.
lines.zh: : 没有谁比你{i}更{/i}配得上我的时间。只要能让你明白这一点，我愿意把每一座钟上的每一根指针都拆下来。

lines.en: : What would you do about the digital ones?
lines.zh: : 那电子钟你怎么办？

lines.en: : I don’t know...turn them off, I guess. {i}Sniffle.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不知道……关掉吧，大概。{i}*抽鼻子*{/i}

lines.en: : Here, use my sleeve.
lines.zh: : 给，用我的袖子。

lines.en: : No...{i}sniffle.{/i} I have a handkerchief...it’s okay. But thank you...
lines.zh: : 不用……{i}*抽鼻子*{/i}我有手帕……没关系的。不过谢谢你……

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : So, is this the first time you’ve ever cried in a sewer?
lines.zh: : 那么，这是你第一次在下水道里哭吗？

lines.en: : Heheh...{i}sniffle.{/i} No...my bowstring snapped once and hit me in the eye. Io had to make me an eye patch and walk me out of here.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……{i}*抽鼻子*{/i}不是……有一次我的弓弦断了，弹到了我眼睛上。Io 给我做了个眼罩，然后扶着我走出了这儿。

lines.en: : Then I guess I can be thankful you’re still capable of moving around on your own right now.
lines.zh: : 那我大概该庆幸你现在还能自己走路。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Akira...my body feels really heavy all of a sudden. I think you might have to carry me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Akira……我的身体突然好沉。我觉得你可能得背我。

lines.en: : Uta-
lines.zh: : Uta——

lines.en: : Ah...sweet death has come to claim poor Uta-chan...
lines.zh: : 啊……甜蜜的死亡来接走可怜的 Uta 酱了……

lines.en: : So horny that...her body...simply could not go on any longer...
lines.zh: : 发骚到……她的身体……再也撑不下去了……

lines.en: : I’ll make sure to mark that down as a note for your gravestone once you get your head out of my lap. You’re on top of my phone.
lines.zh: : 等你把头从我腿上挪开，我一定把这句记下来刻在你的墓碑上。你压着我手机了。

lines.en: : Oh, I thought that was something else.
lines.zh: : 哦，我还以为是别的东西。

lines.en: : You thought my penis was rectangular?
lines.zh: : 你以为我的鸡巴是长方形的？

lines.en: : No, I thought it was your wallet.
lines.zh: : 不，我以为那是你的钱包。

lines.en: : Oh.
: What’s this?
lines.zh: : 这是什么？

lines.en: : {i}That{/i} is my penis.
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}是我的鸡巴。

lines.en: : Really?...
: No, that’s my wallet.
lines.zh: : 不，那是我的钱包。

lines.en: : Mm! Akiraaaa! Don’t tease Uta-chan! She’s very sensitive right now! That’s- ah!
lines.zh: : 嗯！Akira 啊啊！别逗 Uta 酱！她现在很敏感的！那是——啊！

lines.en: scene nightsky
I gently stroke her hair as she lays her head in my lap. Her ears are a shade of red so bright that they rival the fire beside us.
lines.zh: 她把头枕在我腿上，我轻轻抚摸着她的头发。她的耳朵红得发亮，堪比我们身边的那团火。

lines.en: : What are you-
lines.zh: : 你在干什——

lines.en: : Trying to calm you down. Is it working?
lines.zh: : 想让你冷静下来。有用吗？

lines.en: : A little yes...a little no.
lines.zh: : 有一点用……又不太有用。

lines.en: : Why not close your eyes then?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不闭上眼睛呢？

lines.en: : Close my eyes? But what if I fall asleep?
lines.zh: : 闭上眼睛？可要是我睡着了怎么办？

lines.en: : Well, we’d have two options. I could either put you to bed in that homeless person’s mattress...or I could carry you back to your room like you were begging me to do just a minute ago.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那我们有两个选择。要么我把你放到那个流浪汉的床垫上睡觉……要么就像你一分钟前求我的那样，把你背回你的房间。

lines.en: : Okay...can you make me a promise, though?
lines.zh: : 好……不过你能答应我一件事吗？

lines.en: : What’s that?
lines.zh: : 什么事？

lines.en: : If I invite you inside once we get there...can you say no?
lines.zh: : 等我们到了那儿，如果我邀请你进去……你能不能说不？

lines.en: : Uhh...{i}probably not.{/i}
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}大概不能{/i}。

lines.en: : Can you try?...
lines.zh: : 你能试试吗？……

lines.en: : You...really want to keep waiting?
lines.zh: : 你……真的想继续等下去？

lines.en: : Mhm...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……

lines.en: scene black
: I kinda...
lines.zh: : 我有点……

lines.en: : Never want this to end.
lines.zh: : 永远不想让这一刻结束。

lines.en: : But I also {i}really{/i} want you inside of me.
lines.zh: : 可我也{i}真的{/i}想要你进来。

lines.en: : Welp.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : Oh. {i}That’s{/i} gotta be your penis.
lines.zh: : 哦。{i}那{/i}肯定是你的鸡巴。

lines.en: : Sure is, Uta. Thanks for just lying on it.
lines.zh: : 的确是，Uta。谢谢你直接躺在上面。

lines.en: : It’s not a very good pillow. I’m going to adjust. ‘Scuse me!
lines.zh: : 这枕头不太好用。我要调整一下。借过！

lines.en: : I hate you...
lines.zh: : 我恨你……

lines.en: And...
lines.zh: 还有……

lines.en: Something else I don’t want to say.
lines.zh: 还有一句我不想说的话。
